topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I didn’t think anyone would ever see this, just tucked away in the submission portal. There it was, my words, under the sun of the examples section. My step feels a bit lighter, yet each beat of my heart echoes loud. A thousand thoughts dance in my mind, circling the moment I stumbled upon it. Maybe they found something in it, something worth sharing. But what if there’s too much of me, too much that doesn’t fit? The paper feels warm in my hands, the edges curling with each turn. I should be pleased, shouldn’t I? Yet, here I stand, unsure of where to look or what comes next.
